passed_evidence: CMF20 produced positive normal and stress total return in both Design and Validation and had no terminal unrealized inventory in either full window.
Design CMF20 returned 321.45464716 percent versus 129.60544229 percent for buy-and-hold while drawdown was 53.72966641 percent versus 77.18955925 percent.
Validation episode concentration was not excessive at 30.89438259 percent, holding duration stayed bounded, and position changes remained inside the frozen execution-support range.
CMF14 and CMF28 were positive under both Validation cost scenarios and both kept normal Validation drawdown below passive BTC.
material_failure: The Design advantage did not transfer: CMF20 Validation captured only 25.225826 percent of passive upside while drawdown rose to 44.05135660 percent versus passive 32.28416349 percent.
CMF20 Validation Calmar was 2.66139877 versus passive 14.39575015, so lower participation did not produce risk-adjusted improvement.
Annual stability failed with drawdown non-worse only 3/5 years, Calmar breadth only 2/5, upside breadth only 2/5, and 68.48483743 percent of positive annual return concentrated in the top year.
CMF14 captured only 45.093307 percent of Validation upside and CMF28 Calmar reached only 60.686642 percent of passive, below the frozen neighbor gates; neither can replace the failed primary.
material_learning: Single-venue close-location-weighted volume balance was strongly regime-dependent. Its excellent 2020-2022 Design result did not generalize to 2023-2024, where it both missed most upside and suffered more drawdown than passive BTC. The better post-outcome appearance of CMF28 is precisely why rejection-only neighbors cannot become replacement candidates.
